d: Is the world witnessing a shift in the global balance of power? In an exclusive conversation with Firstpost's Hem Kaur Saroya, Col. (Retd.) Douglas MacGregor, PhD, former Senior Advisor to the US Secretary of Defense, examines the changing geopolitical landscape as Donald Trump prepares to engage with Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping. He discusses the growing Russia-China partnership, America's declining military and financial dominance, and Washington's increasingly isolated position.
